title: SqlTestScore
description: A score reported by the external SQL-test tool for a candidate. NEW in round 5. IMPORTANT: this tool's own request contract is NOT confirmed yet (round-5 kickoff note only said 'a separate external system/tool', no shape agreed) - `score` is the one thing decided (a plain finite number), and `raw_payload` keeps whatever else a caller sends verbatim so nothing is lost once the real shape is known. Treat everything here as provisional except the existence of the `score` field.

score.description: Must be finite - Infinity/-Infinity/NaN are rejected with 400.

source.description: Free text identifying which tool/version reported this.

raw_payload.description: Whatever else the caller sent, preserved verbatim. null if nothing extra was sent.

recorded_by.description: hr_accounts.account_id of whoever was logged in when this was recorded, if the call came through a normal HR session. null is possible if/when this moves to a machine-to-machine credential (not built yet - see the open question in CHANGELOG.md).

endpoints.description: Not part of the payload - a summary of the API.
endpoints.POST /api/candidates/{id}/sql-test-score: Any logged-in account (same auth as everything else - see the note above about this possibly needing a service-credential path once the real tool's auth is known). Body: scoreIn. A candidate can be scored more than once; every submission is its own row, nothing is overwritten. -> 201.
endpoints.GET /api/candidates/{id}/sql-test-scores: Every score for the candidate, newest first.
